import re

# Map note_id to group_id
note_to_group = {
    3088: 278,  # Santorini
    3086: 276,  # Venice
    3087: 277,  # Tokyo
    3085: 275,  # Seoul
    3084: 274,  # Cairo
}

# Read all notes again and parse
expenses_by_group = {}
for nid, gid in note_to_group.items():
    note = apis.simple_note.show_note(access_token=access_token, note_id=nid)
    content = note['content']
    expenses = []
    for line in content.splitlines():
        line = line.strip()
        if not line.startswith('- '):
            continue
        # Pattern: - Payer paid $amount for "Description". Owed equally by Name1, Name2, ...
        m = re.match(r'^- (.+?) paid \$(\d+(?:\.\d+)?) for "(.+?)"\. Owed equally by (.+)$', line)
        if m:
            payer = m.group(1).strip()
            amount = float(m.group(2))
            desc = m.group(3).strip()
            owed_str = m.group(4).strip()
            # Split names by comma
            owed_names = [n.strip() for n in owed_str.split(',')]
            expenses.append({
                'description': desc,
                'paid_amount': amount,
                'payer': payer,
                'debtors': owed_names,
            })
    expenses_by_group
